rv.q: Theatregoers arriving at Riverside Studios are in for an evening which has creativity and humour, but with a hefty serving of aimlessness, repetition and unnecessary scorn.
Player is a terrific piece of work, worth fifty minutes of anyone's time, full of wit, sharp observation and yes - honesty.

cn.t: Matthew Lyon's semi-autobiographical actor tale divides critics: some praise his sprightly, original wordplay and linguistic flair, while others find the production dated, repetitive, and sneery despite its evident passion.
